_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_name.label: County Name
county_name.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of_decedent.label: Estate Of Decedent
estate_of_decedent.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

personal_representative_name.label: Personal Representative Name
personal_representative_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

personal_representative_address.label: Personal Representative Address
personal_representative_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required
